patterns.note: Alternating high-contrast color blocks, transitioning from an airy, off-white editorial layout to a deep, dark brown immersive grid.
Elegant, high-contrast serif headings paired with clean, ultra-minimal sans-serif body text and labels.
A sophisticated base of warm off-white and deep dark chocolate brown, allowing the highly saturated, colorful project imagery to pop.
Floating, multi-layered image collages that parallax and shift depth as the user scrolls, creating a dynamic 3D scattering effect.
Minimalist table-style lists with thin horizontal dividers and subtle hover states for service offerings.

technique_notes: Recreate the floating collage effect using absolute positioning and scroll-driven parallax to translate individual rounded-corner images at varying speeds.
Implement a seamless background color transition on scroll, shifting the viewport from a clean cream background to a deep dark brown canvas as the user enters the case studies or footer sections.
Use a high-contrast serif font for large, centered editorial statements with generous letter-spacing and line-height, paired with a strict, low-contrast sans-serif for metadata and UI elements.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (~4-5x body size) contrasted with tiny, widely-spaced sans-serif labels and metadata.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle to rounded: sharp layout lines and table dividers contrasted with soft, heavily rounded corners on all project cards and floating images.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and expansive, utilizing massive vertical margins and generous breathing room around central text blocks.

standout: The site stands out through its masterful transition between an ultra-minimalist, editorial light mode and a dense, vibrant dark-mode portfolio grid, tied together by fluid, multi-layered parallax image collages.
